title: Flexbox Layout
description: Using Flexbox for creating flexible and responsive layout structures easily.

flashcards.question: Which CSS property defines a flex container?
What is the main axis in Flexbox?
flashcards.answer: The primary axis along which flex items are laid out, default is horizontal (row).

flashcards.question: Which property controls the direction of flex items?
Name the possible values of flex-direction.
What does justify-content do in Flexbox?
flashcards.answer: It aligns flex items along the main axis.

flashcards.question: What is the role of align-items in Flexbox?
flashcards.answer: It aligns flex items along the cross axis (perpendicular to main axis).

flashcards.question: How do you make a flex item grow to fill available space?
What does the flex-wrap property control?
flashcards.answer: Whether flex items wrap onto multiple lines or stay on one line.

flashcards.question: What is the difference between align-items and align-content?
flashcards.answer: align-items aligns items within a single line; align-content aligns multiple lines of flex items.
